free_tier.stated: No free tier for text or coding. The page prices MiniMax-M3.1-Flash at USD 0.15 per 1M input tokens and MiniMax-M3 at USD 0.30, and its only free allowance is on input images for the video models.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the vendor console, its own agents, and an OpenAI-compatible key
chaining: there is no free allowance to chain, so every call spends money

limits.value: per-token billing with no free text allowance

identity_cost.detail: an M Plan or API account; the page names no card for signup and no free tier either way

reliability_note: the only free quota on the page is for input images on video models, which a text client never touches

evidence.proved: text models are billed from USD 0.15 per 1M input tokens and the free allowance applies only to input images
evidence.quote: > MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview has been retired. Requests using the old name are now served by MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.
